stage_fields.problem_definition: From paired scMultiome (RNA+ATAC, no spatial) + spatial RNA (no ATAC), infer spatial ATAC via a shared paired latent; CPU-only.
stage_fields.estimand: the unobserved spatial ATAC accessibility at each spot, recovered through the paired RNA-ATAC shared latent (CPU-only, no spatial ATAC data)
stage_fields.objective_or_likelihood: PLS: maximize tr(U^T C_xy V) over orthonormal U,V with C_xy the CENTERED cross-covariance (solved by SVD); latent->ATAC B_atac = argmin||Xa - Z B||^2 (least squares); spatial projection = entropic OT min<P,M> + eps*KL(P||ab) solved by Sinkhorn
stage_fields.identifiability: Spatial ATAC is NOT directly identifiable (no spatial ATAC observed). Identifiable only via the shared paired latent + the OT alignment assumption; degrades when the spatial RNA manifold does not overlap the paired manifold (fb1).

failure_boundaries.condition: spatial spots drawn outside the paired manifold
failure_boundaries.mechanism: OT transport spreads / collapses; barycentric latent falls back to the paired mean -> imputation confident-but-wrong unless flagged
RNA too sparse to localize the spot in the paired latent; flagged low_confidence

failure_boundaries.condition: weak RNA-ATAC pairing (small cross-covariance singular values)
failure_boundaries.mechanism: shared latent carries little ATAC information; B_atac reconstruction uninformative

failure_boundaries.condition: batch shift between paired and spatial data
failure_boundaries.mechanism: OT aligns batch artifact rather than biology

stage_fields.complexity: pair_map: SVD O(min(g,n)^2 * max) + lstsq O(n k^2); project: Sinkhorn O(n_iter * m_in * n), mini-batch over m for scale; CPU-feasible to ~100k spots with mini-batch (POT in production)
